card.name: Digits starting a number in labels
card.fires_on: A digit, or the space just before a digit, that begins a number in drug-label text. It appears in section cross-references like (5.1), in dose ranges, in trial phase and grade numbers, and in day counts.

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: The first digit or the space before it inside a bracketed section reference such as (5.3).

modes.label: Doses and counts
modes.description: The start of a number in a dose range, trial phase, grade or number of days.
modes.example: the recommended dosage range is <<0>>.1 to 0.2 mL
